text:
alex_huang: Heads up — large retail customer asked for an on-prem 'compat mode' to match CompetitorX's inference API surface. They want token-level billing parity and the same response streaming hooks.
priya_rao: Can you paste the ask? is this a blocker for the deal or just a nice-to-have?
alex_huang: Deal is green but engineering compliance + SSO + on-prem is a checklist item. They said "we won't sign until we can map our routing to the same endpoint shape" — so it's leaning toward blocker for enterprise contract.
mattg: Rough engineering take: building a true compatibility layer that preserves our runtime benefits (batching, KV cache) but exposes CompetitorX shape is doable but costly. Need to scope: endpoint surface, auth mapping, streaming protocol.
jamie: From design: we can surface a compatibility flag that morphs response format + streaming envelope. UX risk: docs might get messy.
sarah.k: What are the hard SLOs they require? latency / p95?
alex_huang: They want 200ms p95 for short prompts (<128 tokens) and support for chunked streaming. Also audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.
mattg: 200ms p95 on private infra with our batching might be optimistic unless we allow small-batch/no-batch paths. That increases unit cost.
priya_rao: Sales asked for an estimate to include in the redline timeline. If we can't do full parity, propose a scoped shim + roadmap to full parity.
evan_pm: Proposal: ship Compatibility Shim v1 (API adapter + streaming envelope) w/ opt-out for batching (penalty mode). Launch criteria: 1) matches shapes for 90% of their calls, 2) p95 <= 300ms on their pilot infra, 3) logs to SIEM via syslog connector. If pass, contract moves forward.
mattg: Implementation notes: two paths in runtime — compatibility (no aggregation, passes through tokens) and native (batched). Need a config flag per-tenant and a canary for 5% traffic.
jamie: UX checklist: 1) docs section 'Compatibility mode' 2) migration guide 3) example streaming client (node/python)
sarah.k: Compliance: add requirement for KMS integration and retention policy on logs. Also CDR for audit.
priya_rao: Risk: if we launch shim and it costs 2-3x, will the customer accept price delta? Sales, can you confirm price elasticity?
evan_pm: Sales says pilot budget is flexible but they want a hard timeline: pilot in 6 weeks, GA in 3 months.
mattg: Realistic dev timeline: shim + basic streaming adapter = 4 weeks for prototype, 6 weeks for pilot if we focus no-batch path. Full native-optimized parity (with batching + quant tweaks) is 12+ weeks.
alex_huang: Ok tradeoff decision needed: fast shim to close deal vs hold for optimized route. Thoughts?
jamie: Fast shim is fine as long as we mark as 'compatibility beta' and show roadmapped perf improvements. Docs must make cost/latency explicit.
sarah.k: Legal needs "beta" language in contract and SLAs limited for compatibility mode — we should not promise existing Dedicated SLAs.
priya_rao: My suggested plan: 1) commit to Compatibility Shim v1 for pilot (6 weeks) 2) negotiate contract with pilot credits and 'performance remediation' clause 3) roadmap full parity for Q3 (12 weeks)
evan_pm: Owners: mattg (eng lead), jamie (design), sarah.k (security/compliance), priya_rao (sales coord), alex_huang (stakeholder).
mattg: Tech checklist snippet for implementation:\n```
- tenant.config.compat_mode = true
- runtime: bypass_batching = true
- streaming: envelope = competitorX_v1
- logs: syslog_forwarder + audit=true
```
priya_rao: Deliverables for next sync (2d): eng prototype demo, sample client, draft contract language for beta.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-compat-shim to staging at 1768123600 by @mattg :rocket:
alex_huang: Great. I'll update customer and push contract redline with the suggested pilot credits. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
jamie: I'll start docs + sample client today.
mattg: Will post design doc PR by EOD.
sarah.k: I'll draft compliance appendix and share with legal.
evan_pm: Closing note: decision = ship shim ("beta") to unblock deal, monitor cost delta, and commit to full parity roadmap if pilot metrics require it.
priya_rao: Added to roadmap board as 'compat-shim-customerX' and linked to the ticket.
alex_huang: End of thread — follow-ups tracked in the linked tickets.
